auth_details: API key via query parameter apiKey= (self-serve platform signup); OAuth/JWT also available for enterprise.
free_tier_limits: HERE Free plan includes limited monthly transactions for Location Services (commonly ~250k free transactions/month; verify current quotas at platform.here.com — exact free limits vary by service and plan).
rate_limits: Plan-dependent QPS/rate limits enforced via HERE platform plans; see plan details and service-specific limits (not unpublished).
description: HERE Location Services provide maps, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, traffic, and places APIs used by developers to build location-aware applications. Official docs and self-serve credentials live on the HERE developer platform.
